title: Tymofii Kuzmych - portfolio
bio:
Hello,
My name is Tymofii but you can call me Tim. I am 17 and I am from Ukraine. Since very early childhood I have been interested in different stuff (craft, art, sculpture, architecture, design etc.) but always wanted to make a difference, to influence the world in a new way. I am working hard to reach my goals. Please see below a portfolio of my works (some of them). I hope you will enjoy.
